title: Your first private handoff
recording: Actual local product UI with synthetic sample data. Model calls occur between scenes; waiting is edited. Narration uses a system voice.

chapters.title: Open the setup guide
chapters.instruction: After installing Ninai, open Setup guide. The recording uses the real local interface and sample data.
chapters.success: The fresh guide starts without project access.

chapters.title: Create a project
chapters.instruction: Add a project decision and create a named project for this work.
chapters.success: The named project has separate assistant permissions.

chapters.title: Save one useful decision
chapters.instruction: Write a short decision and save it under your project. Choose Codex as the assistant to test.
chapters.success: The guide detects the saved decision.

chapters.title: Allow Read for this project
chapters.instruction: Choose access, open the assistant card, and enable Read for Launch rehearsal. Save and Delete stay off.
chapters.success: The permission applies only to this named project.

chapters.title: Enable Read, keep Save and Delete separate
chapters.instruction: Turn on Read for Codex. Other project actions remain off.
chapters.success: Only Read is enabled for this assistant and project.

chapters.title: Run the request in your assistant
chapters.instruction: Send this project-specific request to Codex. A real Codex recall ran between these recorded scenes.
chapters.success: Check progress verifies the actual disclosure, not the connection label.

chapters.title: Test revocation
chapters.instruction: Open permissions and turn off Read for the same project. Then ask the assistant to recall again.
chapters.success: Revocation blocks future reads; it cannot erase earlier copies.

chapters.title: Turn project Read off
chapters.instruction: Choose project access and disable Read for Codex. Other assistants keep their own permissions.

chapters.title: Disable the project grant
chapters.instruction: Turn off the Read checkbox. Ask Codex to repeat the same request before checking progress.
chapters.success: The guide waits for an actual denied request.

chapters.title: Verify the denied request
chapters.instruction: Repeat the request after revocation, then check progress. This real Codex request returned no project memories.
chapters.success: Ninai verifies the denied request after revocation.

chapters.title: Inspect what was shared
chapters.instruction: Sharing history shows the successful recall and the denied request, including purpose and token count.
chapters.success: One request shared the memory. The request after revocation shared none.
